shared_phenotypes.label: Abnormality of the epiphysis of the femoral head

neighbours.mechanism_note: Similar symptoms, different cause. rhizomelic chondrodysplasia punctata type 5: peroxisomal biogenesis / peroxisomal enzyme or transporter defect (via MONDO:0019053 peroxisomal disease). GNPTG-mucolipidosis: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails) (via MONDO:0002561 lysosomal storage disease). No shared causal gene; phenotype similarity simGIC 0.17. Assets and trial designs do not transfer between them without expert review. Reactome: no pathway annotated for GNPTG, so pathway overlap 0 is a data gap, not evidence of a different mechanism.
